families.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition

members.gloss: constructing or tending to construct or improve or promote development
members.tone: Approving on two counts at once - it builds and it improves, where *formative* only shapes and leaves the worth of the result open.
Approving at one remove: it credits what fosters making rather than the making itself, a lighter claim than the improvement built into *constructive*.

members.gloss: forming or capable of forming or molding or fashioning
members.tone: Neutral - it names the power to shape without saying the shaping is for the better, which is exactly what *constructive* asserts.

members.gloss: forming or capable of forming or molding or fashioning
members.tone: Bare and unweighted, the act of forming stated as such, where *formative* points instead at the capacity to form.

members.gloss: forming or capable of forming or molding or fashioning
members.tone: Treats the power to mold as a flat property of a thing rather than a merit, which keeps it cooler than *creative*.

members.gloss: based on interpretation; not directly expressed
members.tone: Carries no approval at all - it marks how something is arrived at, by interpretation rather than statement, where *constructive* judges the worth of what is done.

members.gloss: helping to restore to good condition
members.tone: Approving of repair: the good it names is a return to sound condition rather than the new making in *constructive*.

members.gloss: helping to restore to good condition
members.tone: The same restoring good as *reconstructive*, but the longer, more formal word makes the helping sound like a sustained process rather than a single fix.

members.gloss: concerned with systematic structure in a particular field of study
members.tone: Purely descriptive - it places a thing within a system of study and does none of the approving that runs through *constructive*.

families.axis: neutral record of an unworked state → shortfall measured against the state wanted

members.gloss: not brought to the desired final state
members.tone: Carries a faint reproach because the thing is measured against the final state that was wanted, so it records a shortfall rather than merely a stage.

members.gloss: of stone or timber; shaped roughly without finishing
members.tone: Neutral about workmanship - the shaping has been done and only the finishing has not, where *unhewn* denies the shaping altogether.

members.gloss: of stone or timber; shaped roughly without finishing
members.tone: Flatter and more matter-of-fact than *roughhewn*, naming the cut alone without that word's suggestion of ruggedly worked bulk.

members.gloss: of lumber or stone or hides; not finished or dressed
members.tone: Names one specific operation left undone rather than a general falling-short, which keeps it cooler and more technical than *unfinished*.

members.gloss: (of market animals) not optimal for marketing
members.tone: Coolly commercial disparagement - the animal is graded short of what the market wants, a deficiency stated as plain fact rather than complaint.

members.gloss: (of stone especially) not given a finished form by or as if by hewing
members.tone: Denies the shaping outright where *roughhewn* concedes a first pass, and its as-if reach lets it settle on things no tool was ever near.

families.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

members.gloss: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird
members.tone: Carries a faint edge of unease that *unusual* does not - what is strange is not merely rare but slightly off.

members.gloss: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird
members.tone: The flat member of the pair - it records a departure from the expected without *strange*'s hint that something is amiss.
Odd to the point of being laughed at - the strangeness reads as clownish rather than menacing.
Oddness inflated past what belief will carry, so the extravagance itself is the fault.
The more elaborate twin of *fantastic* - the oddness sounds invented rather than merely met with.
The harshest of these - the oddness is distorted enough to repel, where *antic* only invites laughter.
Blunt and informal - it throws up its hands at the strangeness instead of examining it.

members.gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
members.tone: The oddness is inviting - it asks to be looked into, where *queer* asks to be backed away from.

members.gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
members.tone: Marks something as not quite right without saying what is wrong with it, and the vagueness is the unease.

members.gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
members.tone: Registers the deviation flatly, with none of *peculiar*'s second look.

members.gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
members.tone: Fastens the oddness onto the thing itself, as a quality it owns rather than an impression it gives.

members.gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
members.tone: Adds a wariness *odd* lacks - the deviation feels wrong rather than merely noticeable.

members.gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
members.tone: Informal and offhand - the oddness gets a shrug rather than a verdict.

members.gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
members.tone: A lighter, more throwaway ring than *rum*, the same shrug loosened further.

members.gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
members.tone: Deviation read as standing apart rather than as going wrong, so the oddity comes out as distinction where *curious* only makes it inviting.

members.gloss: inspiring a feeling of fear; strange and frightening
members.tone: The strangeness has turned frightening - it works on the nerves rather than on the judgement.

families.axis: bare statement that money comes back → relish at how large the return is

members.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it reports that a return exists and says nothing about its size or how welcome it is, which is the whole of what *juicy* adds.
Approves through certainty rather than size - the profit is treated as already secured, where *profitable* claims only that it is there.
Relish rather than accounting - it praises a return by its sheer thickness, where *profitable* merely records one.
Appetite - it makes the profit tempting, something to be got at, where *fat* only makes it thick.
Measured approval - the return it names is a fair one rather than a large one, which keeps it clear of the greed in *juicy*.
Understated for a return that is fair rather than large - the profit is granted without being praised.
Mildly approving - it treats the return as something the thing keeps doing, where *paid* records only that it happened.
The dry member - it approves by the ledger, granting a reward without any of the appetite in *fat* or *juicy*.
Formal and emphatic at once - the size of the profit is the entire claim, stated without the hunger of *juicy*.
Blunt where *lucrative* is formal - it names the money outright and lets that stand as the praise.
The most formal way to say it - it lends a sizeable profit a decorum that *moneymaking* makes no attempt at.

families.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

members.gloss: not successful; having failed or having an unfavorable outcome
members.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it records the unfavorable outcome and passes no verdict on whoever met it.
Marks the act as the thing that failed rather than the one who made it, which is where it parts from *defeated*.
Failure recast as a loss to something stronger, carrying the sting of being beaten that *unsuccessful* leaves out.
The softest of the blocked set - the failure sits in a hope let down rather than in any force that stopped it, unlike *thwarted*.
Formal, and it puts the disappointment into the failure itself rather than into the effort that led there.
Sounds the note of a scheme blocked at the last moment, lighter and more gleeful than the grim *thwarted*.
Puts the weight on effort spent for nothing, so the failure feels drawn out rather than delivered in one blow like *defeated*.
The hardest of the blocked set - something outside did the stopping, and the word gives that force a weight *foiled* does not.
Informal and final, a verdict pronounced with none of the room for recovery that *frustrated* still leaves open.
Grave rather than colloquial: the ending is total and stated without relish, where *washed-up* sneers.
Blunt and informal, a one-syllable verdict that closes the matter faster than *ruined* does.
Formal and near-elegiac, treating the end as something that came apart rather than something that was smashed.
The most contemptuous of the doomed set - it dismisses as much as it describes, which *undone* never does.

members.gloss: lacking resources (or any prospect of resources)
members.tone: Widens the failure to a whole condition, nothing held and nothing coming, with a bleakness *empty-handed* keeps at arm's length.
Concrete where *unrewarded* is abstract - it shows the nothing instead of naming it.
Neutral and faintly on the subject's side, recording that nothing came of it without calling the effort wasted.

families.axis: entitled to respect → held in profound reverence

members.gloss: worthy of being honored; entitled to honor and respect
members.tone: The plain claim of the family - it certifies that respect is deserved, without the awe *august* and *venerable* pile on top.

members.gloss: worthy of being honored; entitled to honor and respect
members.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the same entitlement to respect as *honorable* with nothing added or softened.
Lofty and formal - it raises the honor so high it puts distance between subject and speaker, where *honorable* stays level with you.
Locates the honor in those who feel it - the regard is actively given, not merely owed as with *honorable*.
Solemn - it wraps the honor in a hush of reverence rather than the ceremonial elevation of *august*.

members.gloss: worthy of the greatest honor or distinction
members.tone: Superlative - it does not merely grant honor but sets its object at the summit of it, where *honorable* only confirms the desert.

members.gloss: honored because of age or long usage
members.tone: Approval with its grounds stated - the honor is credited to having lasted, where *honorable* and *venerable* name the honor without saying what earned it.

members.gloss: honored because of age or long usage
members.tone: The British spelling, endorsing a thing for its endurance in precisely the terms *time-honored* uses.

families.axis: irresponsibility indulged as charm → irresponsibility condemned as unfitness

members.gloss: showing lack of care for consequences
members.tone: The plain charge the rest take their colour from - blame falls on the consequences left unweighed, with none of the cheer of *carefree*.
The most forgiving word here - the missing care reads as freedom from burden rather than neglect of duty.
Bravado rather than lightness - it flaunts the disregard where *carefree* simply has no worry to shed.
Motion with the brakes off - it approves the ease while leaving the absent check audible.
Indulgent - it credits a temperament rather than charging a fault.
Its jingling repetition makes the cheer sound scatterbrained, tipping into scolding where *happy-go-lucky* stays fond.
The cheer here undercuts the person as giddy and unfit to be trusted, where *carefree* leaves them intact.

members.gloss: characterized by inability or unwillingness to work toward a goal or assume responsibility
members.tone: Flatly dismissive - it writes someone off by what they never get done, with no charm allowed into the failing.
A verdict of unfitness rather than a report of behaviour, and the most withering word in the set.

members.gloss: lacking a sense of restraint or responsibility
members.tone: A light word for the fault - what is missing is restraint, not any active wrongdoing.

members.gloss: lacking a sense of restraint or responsibility
members.tone: Carries a moral edge *idle* does not - the restraint gone slack is the kind a person is expected to hold.

members.gloss: irresponsible in the use of firearms
members.tone: The cheerful *-happy* ending set against carelessness with a gun is the whole sting of it.
Positional rather than evaluative - it states the absence of anyone to answer to, without judging the person for it.
Judged from outside - where *irresponsible* looks at the consequences, this looks at whoever was depending.

families.axis: unmixed as a bare fact → purity admired as flawlessness

members.gloss: free of extraneous elements of any kind
members.tone: The unrestricted term of the family — nothing extraneous of any kind survives it, where *clean* answers only to impurity.

members.gloss: (used of cultures of microorganisms) completely free from other organisms
members.tone: Technical and exact: it certifies that a culture of microorganisms holds no other organism, a specification rather than a compliment.
Approving in a plain, physical way — the impurities are gone, and it says so without the ceremony of *pristine*.
Names the same absence of impurity as *clean* but with a livelier, more inviting force.

members.gloss: (of sound or color) free from anything that dulls or dims
members.tone: Praise for a sound or colour that nothing dulls or dims — the brightness is the point, not the absence of dirt that *clean* answers to.

members.gloss: (of sound or color) free from anything that dulls or dims
members.tone: Softer and less emphatic than *clear* for the same undulled sound or colour, approving without insisting.

members.gloss: (of sound or color) free from anything that dulls or dims
members.tone: The negative form makes the dimness explicit, praising a sound or colour by naming what fails to cloud it where *clear* simply asserts the brightness.

members.gloss: free from impurities; having a high or specified degree of purity
members.tone: Gradable where the rest are absolute: purity here is a degree that can be high or specified, so it measures where *pure* merely declares.

members.gloss: as found in nature in the elemental form
members.tone: Descriptive rather than evaluative — it records that the thing already stands in its elemental form in nature, and attaches no credit to that.
The flattest word here, stating that nothing extraneous is mixed in and neither admiring nor disparaging the fact.
Absolute in force where *plain* is merely factual, pressing on the totality of the unmixedness rather than reporting it.
Formal and slightly stiff, denying admixture in so many words rather than asserting purity outright as *pure* does.
The blunt, unceremonious form of that same denial — *unmingled* says it formally, this says it flatly.

members.gloss: completely free from dirt or contamination
members.tone: The admiring extreme — not merely unmixed but wholly untouched by dirt or contamination, a completeness *clean* never claims.

members.gloss: (of an alcoholic drink) stirred or shaken with ice, but served without it
members.tone: A serving instruction rather than a judgement: the drink met the ice and was left without it, and the phrase passes no verdict on the result.
The opposite arrival from *native* — purity reached by being made, stated as a result rather than praised.
